items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Tootie went off with Jimmy Dorsey

ctx.x: At one point we decided we were going to take some lessons and we both went to an old style--I wouldn't call him a martinette, but a very rigid instrucoor type that Billie Fisher had and his name was (inaudible). That began the whole thing of studying. Tootie did it too.

Later on we both went to Teacher's College. At that point Tootie went off with Jimmy Dorsey and started to make a big name for himself. I stuck there, I went with Benny but I didn't make a big name for myself. That was after and we're jumping the gun here.
